items.exampleEn: The students left the building in an orderly way.
items.exampleZh: 學生們有秩序地離開大樓。

items.exampleEn: We sat on a fallen tree and ate our lunch.
items.exampleZh: 我們坐在一棵倒下的樹上吃午餐。

items.exampleEn: Some shells have a beautiful spiral shape.
items.exampleZh: 有些貝殼有漂亮的螺旋形狀。

items.exampleEn: The two colors are distinctly different.
The washing machine is making an abnormal noise.
items.exampleZh: 洗衣機發出不正常的聲音。

items.exampleEn: It is improper to talk loudly in a library.
items.exampleZh: 在圖書館大聲說話是不恰當的。

items.exampleEn: The river moves in a downward direction toward the sea.

items.sentenceEn: The old wooden floor was rotten.
items.sentenceZh: 舊木頭地板已經腐爛了。

items.audioEn: There's a fallen tree on the road by the park, so please take another way to school today.
items.audioZh: 公園旁的路上有一棵倒下的樹，所以今天請走別條路去學校。
items.questionZh: 為什麼今天要走別條路？
options: A tree is blocking the road.

items.sentenceEn: Please wait in an orderly line.
Prices took a downward turn last month.

items.stemEn: The smell came from some ____ eggs in the fridge.
items.stemZh: 那股味道來自冰箱裡一些腐爛的蛋。

items.stemEn: Wearing shorts to a job interview is ____.
items.stemZh: 穿短褲去參加工作面試是不恰當的。

items.passageEn: Last autumn, my family visited an old tower in the park. The ground was covered with fallen leaves. We climbed the spiral stairs to the top. The weather was abnormal that day: it was hot and humid even though it was October. At the top, a guard told a boy that climbing on the wall was improper and dangerous. I distinctly remember the view: the city looked small and orderly. On the way down, we followed a downward path through the trees. We found some apple trees, but most of the apples on the ground were rotten.
items.passageZh: 去年秋天，我們全家參觀了公園裡的一座老塔。地上鋪滿了落葉。我們沿著螺旋樓梯爬到塔頂。那天的天氣很反常：雖然已經十月了，還是又熱又潮濕。在塔頂，一名警衛告訴一個男孩，爬到牆上是不恰當又危險的。我清楚地記得那裡的景色：城市看起來又小又整齊。下來時，我們沿著一條往下的小路穿過樹林。我們發現了一些蘋果樹，但掉在地上的蘋果大多已經爛了。

questions.questionZh: 那天的天氣有什麼特別？

items.promptZh: 我清楚地聽到有人在叫我的名字。
referenceEn: I distinctly heard someone call my name.
I heard someone call my name distinctly.
rubricZh: distinctly 表示「清楚地、明顯地」，例如 distinctly hear 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 rotten 造一個句子，說說你遇過的腐爛食物。
referenceEn: I once found a rotten banana in my school bag.
The rotten smell from the trash can made me feel sick.
rubricZh: rotten 表示「腐爛的」，例如 a rotten apple 等說法
說的是自己的經驗（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）
